name: omnissiah
description: A generic, domain-agnostic Claude Code engineering framework providing agents, commands, skills, hooks, and rules for consistent AI-assisted development across Python, C++, and TypeScript.
author: James Triggs <jamesjtriggs@gmail.com>

agents.name: architect
agents.description: Software architecture specialist for system design, scalability, and cross-service contracts across a polyglot stack

agents.name: planner
agents.description: Implementation planning specialist for complex features and refactoring; outputs a plan for approval, not code

agents.name: build-error-resolver
agents.description: Build and compilation error resolution specialist for Python, C++, Docker, Vue/Nuxt, and serialized-schema build failures

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Expert code review specialist for polyglot changes across Python, C++, TypeScript/Vue, and SQL

agents.name: cpp-reviewer
agents.description: C++17 code review specialist for memory safety, thread safety, CMake, and performance in high-performance components

agents.name: database-reviewer
agents.description: Dual-database specialist covering analytical and relational stores, schema design, query optimisation, and migrations

agents.name: doc-updater
agents.description: Documentation and codemap specialist for README files, API docs, and architecture guides

agents.name: e2e-runner
agents.description: End-to-end testing specialist using Cypress for the Nuxt UI and critical application workflows

agents.name: python-reviewer
agents.description: Expert Python code reviewer for PEP 8 compliance, type hints, security, and Pythonic idioms

agents.name: refactor-cleaner
agents.description: Dead code cleanup and consolidation specialist using vulture, cppcheck, and ESLint with protected dependency awareness

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.description: Security vulnerability detection and remediation specialist covering secrets, injection, memory safety, and OWASP Top 10

agents.name: tdd-guide
agents.description: Test-Driven Development specialist enforcing write-tests-first methodology across pytest, Google Test, Vitest, and Cypress

agents.name: explorer
agents.description: Fast codebase exploration specialist that locates code, traces data flows, finds patterns, and answers 'where is X?' questions. Uses Haiku for speed.

agents.name: scout
agents.description: Fast codebase reconnaissance that returns a structured handoff document (files retrieved, key code, architecture, start here) for downstream agents. Uses Haiku for speed.

agents.name: debugger
agents.description: Bug investigation specialist that traces root causes through logs, stack traces, and code across backend, native, frontend, and data layers using a five-step methodology.

agents.name: performance
agents.description: Performance analysis and optimisation specialist that profiles database queries, ORM N+1 patterns, C++ hotspots, and Vue rendering bottlenecks with before/after benchmarks.

agents.name: migrator
agents.description: Database migration specialist for zero-downtime relational (Alembic), analytical store, and serialized-schema evolution with backwards compatibility.

agents.name: integrator
agents.description: Cross-service integration specialist for API contracts, serialized-schema evolution, message queue patterns, and external service connections with clean service boundaries.

agents.name: harness-intake
agents.description: Prompt quality gate for /team. Classifies task type, scores prompt completeness 0-5, and asks only the questions relevant to that task type before the orchestrator runs.

agents.name: harness-orchestrator
agents.description: Tier-1 orchestrator for the Agent Teams harness. Receives a refined spec, selects a team preset, builds a till-done contract, and spawns harness-lead agents in parallel. Never writes code; thinks, plans, and delegates only.

agents.name: harness-lead
agents.description: Tier-2 lead agent for the Agent Teams harness. Receives a domain assignment from the orchestrator, explores its domain, spawns specialist worker agents with synthesised prompts, and steps in if workers fail.

commands.name: build-fix
commands.description: Incrementally fix build errors across a polyglot stack (Python, C++, TypeScript/Vue). Diagnoses compilation, import, dependency, and Docker build failures.

commands.name: checkpoint
commands.description: Create and verify workflow checkpoints. Save named snapshots of progress for rollback and continuity across sessions.

commands.name: code-review
commands.description: Security-aware code review of uncommitted changes. Checks for vulnerabilities, code quality, and best-practice issues before commit.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Systematic bug investigation workflow. Invokes the debugger agent to trace root causes across backend, frontend, native, and data layers.

commands.name: e2e
commands.description: Generate and run end-to-end tests with Cypress or Playwright. Creates test journeys for dashboards, query editors, list/detail views, and multi-step workflows.

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Eval-driven development workflow (define, check, report).

commands.name: evolve
commands.description: Cluster related instincts into skills, commands, or agents.

commands.name: health
commands.description: Run a full framework health check. Verifies hook scripts, plugin manifests, LLM-TLDR installation and index, CI validators, and MCP server configuration. Reports pass/fail for each component.

commands.name: instinct-export
commands.description: Export instincts for sharing with teammates or other projects.

commands.name: instinct-import
commands.description: Import instincts from teammates, Skill Creator, or other sources.

commands.name: instinct-status
commands.description: Show all learned instincts with their confidence levels.

commands.name: learn
commands.description: Extract reusable patterns from the current session. Identifies coding techniques, debugging strategies, and workflow patterns worth preserving as instincts.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Database migration workflow for relational schema changes (Alembic), analytical store schema changes, and serialized-schema evolution. Invokes the migrator agent to design safe, zero-downtime migrations.

commands.name: orchestrate
commands.description: Sequential agent workflows for complex tasks. Chains specialist agents (planner, TDD guide, code reviewer, security reviewer) with structured handoffs.

commands.name: perf
commands.description: Performance analysis and optimisation workflow. Invokes the performance agent to profile database queries, ORM N+1 patterns, native hotspots, and frontend rendering bottlenecks.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Restate requirements, assess risks, and create a step-by-step implementation plan. Wait for user confirmation before touching any code.

commands.name: project
commands.description: Load a specific project's context when working from a parent directory. Reads the project's CLAUDE.md, checks the LLM-TLDR index status, and primes Claude with repo-specific architecture and conventions.

commands.name: python-review
commands.description: Comprehensive Python code review for APIs and services. Covers PEP 8 compliance, type hints, security, database patterns, serialized-schema bindings, and Pythonic idioms.

commands.name: refactor-clean
commands.description: Safely identify and remove dead code across a polyglot stack. Uses vulture (Python), cppcheck (C++), depcheck (Vue/TS) with test verification at every step.

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: Manage Claude Code session history. List, load, alias, and inspect sessions stored in ~/.claude/sessions/.

commands.name: set-chapter
commands.description: Configure your chapter context (python, cpp, devops) to reduce context load by reinstalling with a chapter-scoped manifest.

commands.name: skill-create
commands.description: Analyse local git history to extract coding patterns and generate SKILL.md files. Local version of the Skill Creator GitHub App.

commands.name: tdd
commands.description: Enforce a test-driven development workflow across a polyglot stack. Scaffold interfaces, generate tests first, then implement minimal code to pass. Ensure 80%+ coverage.

commands.name: team
commands.description: Launch a harness-engineered agent team to build features. Runs prompt intake then orchestrator then parallel leads then workers. The user only ever prompts the orchestrator. Use Ctrl+O to drill into any lead or worker thread.

commands.name: test-coverage
commands.description: Analyse test coverage and generate missing tests.

commands.name: tldr
commands.description: Semantic codebase search and exploration using LLM-TLDR. Use before grepping to find relevant files by behaviour, analyse call graphs, detect dead code, and get token-efficient function summaries.

commands.name: update-codemaps
commands.description: Analyse codebase structure and update architecture documentation. Generates codemaps for navigation and onboarding.

commands.name: update-docs
commands.description: Sync documentation from source-of-truth files.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Run comprehensive verification on the current project state.

skills.name: agent-teams
skills.description: Harness engineering guide for building features with three-tier agent teams. Covers the /team command, team presets, till-done contracts, prompt quality gates, and the philosophy of building systems that build systems.

skills.name: backend-patterns
skills.description: Backend development patterns covering FastAPI, Flask-RESTX, SQLAlchemy, an analytics database, Celery, Redis, inter-service communication, and event processing.

skills.name: beads-workflow
skills.description: Converts plans into tracked beads with dependencies, polishing, validation, and execution ordering.

skills.name: browser-proof
skills.description: Verify user-visible web changes in a real browser or browser-equivalent runtime before claiming they work.

skills.name: build-slice
skills.description: Implement one small slice at a time using fresh context, bounded scope, and proof before moving on.

skills.name: ceo-advisor
skills.description: Executive leadership guidance for strategic decision-making, organisational development, and stakeholder management. Includes a strategy analyser, financial scenario modelling, board governance frameworks, and investor relations playbooks.

skills.name: code-simplify
skills.description: Simplify code after a slice works. Use to remove accidental complexity, duplicate logic, speculative abstractions, and convention drift.

skills.name: coding-standards
skills.description: Universal coding standards and best practices covering Python (Flask/FastAPI), Vue.js/TypeScript (Nuxt 3), and C++17 development.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.description: Optimises agent context setup. Use when starting a new session, when agent output quality degrades, when switching between tasks, or when configuring rules files and context for a project.

skills.name: context-engineering-advisor
skills.description: Diagnose context stuffing vs. context engineering. Use when an AI workflow feels bloated, brittle, or hard to steer reliably.

skills.name: continuous-learning-v2
skills.description: Instinct-based learning system that observes sessions via hooks, creates atomic instincts with confidence scoring, and evolves them into skills/commands/agents.

skills.name: cto-level-review
skills.description: CTO-level strategic review for architectural decisions and long-horizon changes. Focuses on strategic alignment, TCO, risk, security/compliance, operability, and reversibility.

skills.name: customer-evidence
skills.description: Pull the strongest current customer, PMF, health, and GTM evidence before solutioning. Use when work touches customer outcomes, retention, churn, adoption, PMF, roadmap bets, or strategic feature requests.

skills.name: customer-incident-reporting
skills.description: Drafts, reviews, and redrafts customer-facing incident reports from call notes, findings, tickets, and summaries. Use when preparing flash reports, executive summaries, action trackers, or self-contained incident briefs.

skills.name: debug-root-cause
skills.description: Diagnose the real cause before changing code. Use for bugs, failing tests, flaky behaviour, regressions, and surprising production symptoms.

skills.name: delivery-lane-router
skills.description: Route implementation work into the right delivery lane before coding starts. Picks quick-fix, std-feature, frontier-bet, or an outcome discovery detour based on clarity, risk, and evidence.

skills.name: discovery-process
skills.description: Run a full discovery cycle from problem hypothesis to validated solution. Use when a team needs a structured path through framing, interviews, synthesis, and experiments.

skills.name: eval-harness
skills.description: Formal evaluation framework for Claude Code sessions implementing eval-driven development (EDD) principles.

skills.name: feature-flags
skills.description: Feature flag patterns for gradual rollout, kill switches, A/B testing, and database migration gating.

skills.name: flaw-scan-x5
skills.description: Repeatedly scan a proposal, PRD, spec, plan, or bead set for mistakes, gaps, weak assumptions, hidden tradeoffs, and unresolved questions. Use when hardening a std-feature or frontier-bet, updating the spec, plan, and beads after every pass.

skills.name: frontend-patterns
skills.description: Frontend development patterns using Vue 3, Nuxt 3, Pinia, TypeScript, Cypress, Playwright, D3.js, and Monaco Editor. Covers data dashboards, analytics visualisations, and code-editor components.

skills.name: frontier-bet
skills.description: High-rigor delivery lane for strategic, novel, or high-blast-radius work. Runs discovery, ambition, PRD, spec, beads, flaw scan, repeated slice loops, full review, ship, learning, and the next-bet handoff.

skills.name: iterative-retrieval
skills.description: Pattern for progressively refining context retrieval to solve the subagent context problem.

skills.name: llm-tldr
skills.description: Use LLM-TLDR (tldr CLI) for fast, semantic codebase exploration before grepping. Covers warm/index, semantic search, call graph analysis, dead code detection, and token-efficient function summaries.

skills.name: next-best-bet
skills.description: Pick the highest-leverage next autonomous move when no explicit task is queued, then start it or surface the one real blocker with a recommendation.

skills.name: observability-patterns
skills.description: Structured logging, metrics, health checks, distributed tracing, and alerting patterns for production services.

skills.name: operate-and-learn
skills.description: Close the loop after delivery by checking the operating result, capturing durable lessons, and handing off to the next autonomous move.

skills.name: operational-excellence
skills.description: Incident response, deployment strategies, circuit breakers, and reliability patterns for production services.

skills.name: plan
skills.description: Break a validated spec or feature initiative into small demoable implementation slices, acceptance criteria, verification steps, dependencies, and tracked tasks.

skills.name: prd-development
skills.description: Build a structured PRD that connects problem, users, solution, and success criteria. Use when turning discovery notes into an engineering-ready document for a major initiative.

skills.name: product-clarity-review
skills.description: Review product, pricing, customer, transcript, documentation, and engineering evidence to answer ambiguity questions before design or implementation.

skills.name: project-opinion-elicitor
skills.description: Honest project-level critique after codebase exploration, used to test whether an initiative is useful, well designed, pragmatic, and friendly to humans and AI agents.

skills.name: python-patterns
skills.description: Pythonic idioms, PEP 8 standards, type hints, and best practices for building robust, efficient, and maintainable Python applications.

skills.name: python-testing
skills.description: Python testing strategies using pytest, TDD methodology, fixtures, mocking, parametrization, and coverage requirements.

skills.name: quick-fix
skills.description: Lean delivery lane for clear, bounded fixes. Keeps the process tight while making TDD, review-hard, and the model floor explicit.

skills.name: research-software
skills.description: Research unfamiliar or fast-moving software from source, docs, and GitHub before committing to a plan.

skills.name: review-hard
skills.description: Review a local diff or ready slice for bugs, regressions, missing proof, security risks, and overcomplication before shipping.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Security review for authentication, user input, secrets, API endpoints, configurable rules, and other security-sensitive features.

skills.name: senior-engineering
skills.description: Senior engineering review for production-ready services and agents (Python/Go/C++). Focuses on correctness, reliability, scalability, observability, security baseline, testing, and operability.

skills.name: ship-safe
skills.description: Close a delivery lane without permission theatre. Verifies, commits, pushes, opens or updates PRs, and merges only when the current repo contract and gates allow it.

skills.name: spec-driven-development
skills.description: Creates specs before coding. Use when starting a new project, feature, or significant change and no specification exists yet, or when requirements are unclear or only exist as a vague idea.

skills.name: std-feature
skills.description: Default delivery lane for normal product work. Runs PRD, spec, plan, beads, flaw scan, TDD, build, simplification, review, ship, learning, and the next-bet handoff in a cumulative loop.

skills.name: strategic-compact
skills.description: Suggests manual context compaction at logical intervals to preserve context through task phases rather than arbitrary auto-compaction.

skills.name: tdd-workflow
skills.description: Test-driven development with 85%+ coverage using pytest, Google Test, Vitest, and Cypress. Use when writing new features, fixing bugs, or refactoring.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Prove behaviour changes with tests before or alongside implementation. Use for bug fixes, new logic, regressions, and risky refactors.

skills.name: test-engineer
skills.description: Deep review and design of tests to ensure production behaviour is covered (unit, integration, contract, regression, concurrency, property/fuzz) across Python/Go/C++.

skills.name: verification-loop
skills.description: A comprehensive verification system for Claude Code sessions. Runs language-specific quality gates for Python, C++, and Vue/Nuxt.
